verdict.rationale: The only first-party background behaviour in the evidence is "Follow companies" and "Get emails", which suggest passive update alerts. The keyed REST API (GET-based, with an auth challenge confirmed by probe) could drive automations the user builds and hosts elsewhere. Companies House itself documents no scheduled jobs, triggers or autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: native user-configurable automations or scheduled tasks, webhooks or event triggers for filings, documentation of how follow alerts work, and any hands-on evidence of autonomous background runs.
